en: Black-and-white postcard-style photograph of a steamship moving across calm water. The vessel is decorated with signal flags running from bow to stern. There are crew or passengers visible on deck, and smoke is coming from the funnel. Printed text beneath the image describes the ship S/S Bencas, its owner in Oslo, its tonnage and cargo capacity, and the Norwegian shipyard where it was built.
